serviceToken.description: SecretInput shared with the SFoA CRM chat access service. Prefer a SecretRef. Required before any turn is accepted.

allowRemoteService.description: Allow the CRM ingress from a non-loopback access service. Default false: only same-host requests are accepted.

maxMessageChars.description: Maximum accepted user message length in UTF-16 characters. Defaults to 16000.

turnTimeoutMs.description: Maximum wall-clock time for one agent turn before it is aborted as CRM_TURN_TIMEOUT. Defaults to 600000.

historyLimit.description: Maximum messages returned by one history call. Defaults to 50.
